name: Banana Milk Shake
description: A classic, creamy banana milk shake made with fresh bananas, cold milk, and ice. Simple, refreshing, and perfect for breakfast or a quick snack.
fun_fact: The modern milkshake became popular in the 1920s when electric blenders were invented, making it easy to mix ice cream and milk together into a smooth drink.
instructions: Add sliced bananas and ice to a blender.
Add honey and vanilla if desired.
Blend on high speed for 30-45 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately.
Optional: top with a banana slice or a drizzle of honey.
